name: Kanál Svobodného přístavu: A Verified Quote with a Timestamp
description: Produces a verified, timestamped quote from a Kanál Svobodného přístavu video: locates the moment (search_quotes on transcribed videos with get_passage, or a quick captions transcription), re-transcribes just a 60 to 120 second window with the strongest model (faster-whisper large-v3 or Groq) before quoting, attributes the words to Urza or Tereza only when the video makes the speaker unambiguous, and quotes with a timestamp link and the label strojový přepis, or paraphrases when in doubt. When transcription is impossible here, says why and gives the exact command; never presents remembered or invented wording as a speaker's words. Variables: video_url, claim, approx_time, speaker, count.
content:
# Kanál Svobodného přístavu: a verified quote with a timestamp

## Task
- Video: {{video_url}}
- What the quote should show: {{claim}}
- Approximate time: {{approx_time}}
- Speaker: {{speaker}}
- How many quotes: {{count}}

## 1. Locate the moment
- Video not known yet ("find"): run `liberty-ksp-video-find-transcribe` first.
- Already transcribed: `search_quotes(query=<Czech terms>, sources=["youtube"])`, then `get_passage(chunk_id=…)` for the window with its [mm:ss] markers.
- Not transcribed: transcribe with a fast engine to locate (`engine="captions"`), then search.

## 2. Verify the window
Before quoting, re-transcribe only that window with the strongest model: `transcribe(src=<url>, clip="MM:SS-MM:SS", engine="faster-whisper", model="large-v3")` or `engine="groq"`, about 60 to 120 seconds around the moment; poll `job_status`, then read the new transcript. Small models garble Czech badly: never quote from `base`, `small` or raw captions.

## 3. Attribute
The transcripts have no speaker labels. Attribute words to Urza or Tereza only when the video makes the speaker unambiguous (a single-speaker lecture, the speaker named on screen or in the title). Otherwise write "ve videu zaznělo".

## 4. Quote
Under `liberty-citation-rules`. For each quote: the words copied from the verified transcript, marked *(strojový přepis)*; the timestamp link `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>&t=<seconds>s`; the video's title and date; one line on what it shows. When the wording is still uncertain, paraphrase: „Urza ve videu … (čas 12:34) vysvětluje, že …“.

## 5. When it cannot be transcribed here
Say concretely why (no toolkit, YouTube blocks cloud servers, no GPU and no key) and give the exact command: `liberty transcribe <url> --clip MM:SS-MM:SS --engine faster-whisper --model large-v3`. Never present remembered or invented wording as the speaker's words.

variables.name: video_url
variables.description: The video URL, or 'find' to look for one on the topic of the claim.

variables.name: claim
variables.description: What the quote should show, e.g. 'nezamýšlené důsledky drogové prohibice'.
